body: Yahoo Sports headlines frame Baker Mayfield's zero-completion performance against the Atlanta Falcons as a "horrific" loss and a reason to revisit NFL history, suggesting a critical tone regarding his play. Conversely, Sky Sports reports on a different game where Mayfield set a remarkable stat, while the Tampa Bay Buccaneers' official press conference features Mayfield stating, "Whatever It Takes to Win," indicating a focused, determined attitude from the player himself.
headline: Mixed reactions: Yahoo Sports criticizes Mayfield's zero-completion game, while he vows to win regardless.
